component.name: JALTRIX
component.summary: Investigate Snort alerts and manage a Linux sensor
Investiga alertas de Snort y administra un sensor Linux

description.p: Independent native desktop console for Snort 3 with American English and Latin American Spanish interfaces.

Investigate JSON alerts, PCAP and PCAPNG evidence, manage cases and analyst mappings, and control an explicitly configured sensor. Demonstration data is isolated from real alerts. Snort is installed separately.
Privileged changes require a preview and administrator authorization. Endpoint isolation is unavailable without a configured and tested EDR provider.
